scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-kyotsuten-bingo
scripts.dev:emu: VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true VITE_DEFAULT_EVENT_ID=demo npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.seed:emu: FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-kyotsuten-bingo tsx scripts/create-event.ts --id demo --name デモイベント --passphrase もみじ --admin-key admin
